model_output.verdict: Your payments infrastructure work at Brightline shows a credible progression to Staff Software Engineer. The ledger redesign and duplicate-charge work back up that title. I'd want to know how large the team you lead is and how much traffic the ledger handles.
write_up: Your resume tells a coherent story from object storage at Nimbus Cloud to ledger and settlement leadership at Brightline Payments. The technical work is concrete, and I'd move it forward for a staff engineering role. The main question is how large the platform team and its work are.
